feats.title: Ancient Covenant of Nessus
feats.description: When using a divine encounter or daily attack power on your turn, you may replace your covenant manifestation: offer one target a basic attack as a free action. If it attacks, it then takes 5 + Intelligence fire damage. This becomes 10 + Intelligence at level 11 and 15 + Intelligence at level 21.

feats.title: Blood Pact of Cania
feats.description: Warlock powers that attack using Constitution gain +2 to damage rolls, increasing to +3 at level 11 and +4 at level 21.

feats.title: Blood Quarry
feats.description: Bloodhunt grants +2 to attack rolls against your quarry instead of +1.

feats.title: Burning Wrath of Phlegethos
feats.description: Using Infernal Wrath against your Oath of Enmity target adds fire damage equal to your Intelligence to your melee attacks against it through the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Cloying Shadow of Maladomini
feats.description: If a melee attack hits you while Shadow Walk grants you concealment, you gain combat advantage against that attacker through the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Cunning Ambusher
feats.description: Infernal Wrath deals extra damage equal to your Dexterity when its target grants you combat advantage.

feats.title: Fiendish Companion
feats.description: Your beast companion gains fire resistance of 5 + one-half your level.

feats.title: Hellbook
feats.description: After each extended rest, select a fear or fire daily wizard attack spell in your spellbook. You may use a minor action to exchange a prepared, unused daily wizard attack spell for the selected spell; the replaced spell must be of the same level or higher.

feats.title: Hellfire Arcanist
feats.description: Gain a +2 feat bonus to fire attack damage rolls; this becomes +3 at level 11 and +4 at level 21. Increase any push, pull, or slide from your fear attacks by 2 squares.

feats.title: Hellfire Master
feats.description: An enemy that saves against an effect of your fire attack takes 5 + Charisma fire damage.

feats.title: Hellfire Terror Lord
feats.description: An enemy that saves against an effect of your fear attack falls prone.

feats.title: Hellish Blast
feats.description: You may give Eldritch Blast fire damage and the Fire keyword. When you do, add 1 to its damage roll, increasing to 2 at level 11 and 3 at level 21.

feats.title: Infernal Clamor
feats.description: When you use Infernal Wrath, allies who can see you gain a +1 power bonus to their next attack against the triggering enemy. They must make that attack by the end of that enemy's next turn.

feats.title: Infernal Touch of Warding
feats.description: Lay on Hands also gives its target fire resistance equal to 5 + one-half your level for the rest of the encounter.

feats.title: Insatiable Rage of Minauros
feats.description: While raging, gain +2 to melee damage rolls, but take 2 damage if your turn ends without you having damaged an enemy that turn. Both amounts become 3 at level 11 and 5 at level 21.

feats.title: Lingering Wrath
feats.description: Using Infernal Wrath on an enemy you have marked grants +1 to attack rolls against it for as long as your mark remains on it.

feats.title: Mark of the Infernal
feats.description: Infernal Wrath also subjects its target to your Divine Sanction through the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Nessian Rejuvenation
feats.description: Allies receiving temporary hit points from your Arcane Rejuvenation add fire damage equal to your Charisma to their damage rolls through the end of their next turn.

feats.title: Rattling Wrath
feats.description: After Infernal Wrath, your rattling powers against its target impose a -4 attack penalty in place of -2 through the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Stirring Song of Baator
feats.description: Hitting with a bard fire or fear attack grants an ally who can see you temporary hit points equal to 1 + Charisma. This becomes 3 + Charisma at level 11 and 5 + Charisma at level 21.

feats.title: Turathi Spirit Companion
feats.description: Bloodhunt grants +2 to attack rolls instead of +1 when your spirit companion is adjacent to the bloodied enemy.

feats.title: Vengeful Curse
feats.description: When an enemy hits you, you may use Warlock's Curse on it as an immediate reaction, regardless of whether it is the nearest enemy.

feats.title: Wizard's Wrath
feats.description:
You ignore bloodied enemies' fire resistance and fire immunity. Replace Infernal Wrath with the following power.

*Wizard's Wrath:* Encounter, Arcane, Zone. Minor action; area burst 1 within 10 squares.

*Effect:* The burst becomes a zone of arcane energy that lasts until the end of your next turn. You gain combat advantage against targets in the zone, and they lose all immunities and resistances against your attacks.
